newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela '97 average inflation 40-50 pct - Casas.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela '97 average inflation 40-50 pct - Casas.

text.p: Average inflation this year in Venezuela is expected to be between 40 and 50 percent, Central Bank President Antonio Casas Gonzalez said Friday.

"If we set a target for inflation of 25 percent (for 1997), average inflation would be 40 percent, and not 25 percent. But if the inflation target is 30 percent, as (Planning) minister Teodoro Petkoff has said, then average inflation would be 50 percent," he told a congressional committee.

Petkoff said last week Venezuela's inflation target for 1997 had probably been thrown off track by recent pay rise offers made to militant public sector workers. He said the original target of 25 percent "could rise a little."

Independent analyts say the government's initial hopes to slash inflation from a record 103 percent last year to under 30 percent in 1997 were far-fetched and now forecast price rises of about 50 percent.
